name: com.bird3d.cursor
description: Bird3D cursor developed by MIT Media Labs

samples.description: Two synthetic Bird cursors with pose, radius and selection controls. No tracking SDK or headset required.
Nested menus with customizable visual states, a twelve-color back-surface spherical selector, and map rotation/range zoom. Desktop input or caller-fed logical Bird points.
Paired tabletop and full-scale building puzzles sharing bounded grip, approach guidance, placement and cancellation. Desktop or caller-fed logical input.
